title: Principal Component Analysis
signature: def pca(X: np.ndarray, k: int) -> tuple
hints: Center the columns first. Then the sample covariance is Xc^T Xc / (n - 1).
np.linalg.eigh returns eigenvalues in ascending order, with eigenvectors as columns. Reverse both, take the first k, and transpose to rows.
An eigenvector is only defined up to sign. For each component, find the entry with the largest absolute value and flip the component if that entry is negative.
